items.title: Reef Recovery Training
items.body: Help with marine habitat restoration and community fieldwork. You must be a registered undergraduate or be nominated by a partner organization.

eligibility_evidence.eligibility_quote: You must be a registered undergraduate or be nominated by a partner organization.

items.title: Field Technician Apprentice
items.body: Rehabilitate native prairies, collect biodiversity data and supervise volunteer field crews. A driving license may be required for some field sites.

items.title: Wetland Methods Grant
items.body: Design field protocols that restore wetland habitats and test flood resilience. Awards depend on matching funds.

items.title: Odbudowa rzek i mokradeł
items.body: Przywracanie siedlisk rzecznych, terenowe badania bioróżnorodności i praca z lokalnymi grupami.

items.title: Quality Assurance Associate
items.body: Run sterile manufacturing quality assurance checks and monitor cleanroom contamination. Prior supervisory work is preferred.

items.title: Manufacturing Process Apprentice
items.body: Assure production quality and validate sanitation controls on a sterile packaging line. Training includes verification of equipment maintenance.

items.title: Aseptic Validation Practice
items.body: Validate aseptic production, review cleanroom records and investigate contamination failures. A separate application link is expected next month.

items.title: أخصائي ضمان الجودة
items.body: مراقبة الجودة في التصنيع المعقم ومراجعة سجلات غرف الإنتاج النظيفة.

items.title: Quality Assurance and Packaging Operator
items.body: Perform quality assurance checks for sterile manufacturing. A valid forklift license is required at the time of application.

eligibility_evidence.eligibility_quote: A valid forklift license is required at the time of application.

items.title: Executive Receptionist
items.body: Answer calls, route deliveries and book meeting rooms. Equal opportunity statement: this policy applies to quality assurance and habitat restoration positions, too.

items.title: Science Pitch Challenge
items.body: Compete for a one-time prize. Applicants must be under 18 on the event date. Historical results were published in 2023.
